rule_types.after: pedals: ids that must come BEFORE the rule's pedal
rule_types.before: pedals: ids that must come AFTER the rule's pedal
rule_types.after_group: group: a tag; the pedal must come after every pedal in the project with that tag
rule_types.before_group: group: a tag; the pedal must come before every pedal in the project with that tag
rule_types.no_buffered_before: no pedal with buffered_bypass=true may come earlier in the chain
rule_types.as_early_as_possible: sits right after the pedals its own 'after' rules require
rule_types.strength: 'required' fails validation if violated; 'preferred' only warns
rule_types.scope: rules listed on a catalog pedal are intrinsic (apply in every project); projects add their own in project.json and can disable or soften catalog rules by id via rule_overrides
rule_types.clocked_noise: true for time-based effects (BBD or digital delay/chorus/flanger) and anything digital: they can inject clock noise, so a project's power_policy keeps them off outputs shared with compressors and gain pedals
rule_types.priority: optional integer (default 0): when two rules order the same pair of pedals oppositely, the higher priority wins and the other is reported as overridden; equal priorities fail the build. Project sections default to -10.
rule_types.power_consumption: min_voltage_v / max_voltage_v: the DC voltage range the pedal accepts (e.g. 9-18 means 9, 12, 15 or 18 V are fine). The project picks the operating voltage through the supply output it is wired to; the build only checks that it is inside the range. current_ma is the worst case over that range. polarity: center_negative (the 2.1 mm standard) or center_positive; owner 2026-10-22: every current pedal is center-negative.

pedals.name: Sun Face BC183

dependencies.reason: AnalogMan: the Fuzz Face must see the guitar directly; no buffered pedal ahead of it

pedals.comments: Silicon Fuzz Face, unbuffered: must be FIRST in the chain, guitar straight into it. Ships battery-only; check your unit has the optional DC jack. Silicon version is negative ground so sharing power is OK, but AnalogMan warns a supply can add hum/oscillation. 'Under 1 mA' is from the shared Fuzz Face page. Power re-checked 2026-10-21: no source publishes a current draw, so 1 mA is unverified; AnalogMan never forbids higher than 9V but gives no range either.
